verdict.rationale: The OpenAI Agents SDK is an open-source Python/JS library (github.com/openai/openai-agents-python) that runs entirely in the developer's own process/infrastructure — there is no required hosted backend for the core orchestration, tools, handoffs, guardrails, and tracing primitives, so it is inherently self-hostable by design. missing for 10: no explicit vendor statement framing it as 'self-hostable' or deployment guide for self-managed infra, and no independent hands-on confirmation of running it fully disconnected from OpenAI-hosted services (e.g., with non-OpenAI models) in production.
